steps.caption: Call factorial(4), pushed on the stack. It needs factorial(3) first, so it waits.
Call factorial(3), pushed on the stack. It needs factorial(2) first, so it waits.
Call factorial(2), pushed on the stack. It needs factorial(1) first, so it waits.
Call factorial(1), pushed on the stack. Base case!
factorial(1) returns 1, popped off the stack.
factorial(2) returns 2 (= 2 × 1), popped off the stack.
factorial(3) returns 6 (= 3 × 2), popped off the stack.
factorial(4) returns 24 (= 4 × 6), popped off the stack.
Stack empty. Max depth was 4 frames, so space is O(n).
